sloka: प्रवेश्यमानम् सत्कृत्य नरेन्द्रेण इन्द्र कर्मणा ।यथा दिवि सुरेन्द्रेण सहस्राक्षेण काश्यपम् ॥१-११-२८॥
transliteration: praveśyamānam satkṛtya narendreṇa indra karmaṇā ।yathā divi surendreṇa sahasrākṣeṇa kāśyapam ॥1-11-28॥

translations.english: He (king Dasaratha) took him in to the inner apartment and extended welcome. He thought that he has as enjoined by the sastras accomplished his objective by bringing him (Rsyasringa).
translations.hindi: नगर में मुनि के पहुँचते ही इन्द्रदेव ने रोमपाद के राज्य में जल बरसाया जिससे सब प्राणी प्रसन्न हो गए
